destination.name: Taizhou
destination.tagline: A Yangtze-side hub whose sights spread across Hailing, Gaogang and Jiangyan
destination.description: Taizhou has a history of over 2,000 years and was first established as Tangyue under the Qin dynasty. Its urban core is Hailing District, with Gaogang and Jiangyan beside it, and locals saying Taizhou usually mean Hailing. Hailing was once counted among the Four Lings with Yangzhou, Changzhou and Nanjing, and Jiangyan is known as the Land of Fish and Rice. Temples, memorial halls and old neighbourhoods are the main reasons to stop.
whyVisit: Visit temples and memorial halls in Hailing

goodToKnow.title: Carry Chinese addresses
goodToKnow.detail: English is not widely spoken and most taxi drivers will not read English hotel names. Keep destinations written in Chinese characters.

goodToKnow.title: Shared airport
goodToKnow.detail: Yangzhou Taizhou Airport sits between the two cities, about 40 km east of Yangzhou's centre. Flights are mostly domestic, with some to Japan and South Korea.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Visit in {months} for comfortable temperatures and less rain than the hot, wet summer.
